newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Telmex a N.Y. ADR standout.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Telmex a N.Y. ADR standout.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico rose on Wednesday to highlight trade in American Depositary Receipts.

Traders said the bellwether Mexican stock was boosted by news Mexico would repay the U.S. ahead of schedule $3.5 billion outstanding on an emergency loan granted two years ago in the midst of a fiscal crisis. Mexico also will pay the International Monetary Fund $1.5 billion.
Telmex was up 7/8 to 38-3/4 in heavy volume. The stock was among the most active traded on the New York Stock Exchange in late afternoon.

Brazilian telecommunications holding Telebras also rose 5/8 to 84-1/4, close to a 12-month high, on heavy volume. Latin American stocks have been helped since the start of the year as investors switch money from fixed-income funds to equities.
Among European shares, Dutch software firm Baan Co NV rose 2-3/4 to a 12-month high of 44-1/4. The rise came after Salomon Brothers raised the company's rating to buy from hold.
French semiconductor maker SGS-Thomson Microelectronics NV rose two to 75-3/8, pulled higher by strong profit growth at Intel Corp.
Advancers led decliners by a margin of 318 to 251 among an 807-ADR index. Volume was 71 million shares in mid-afternoon.
